rapport_notes: Warm, friendly tone throughout; patient with customer hesitation and administrative questions; handled awkward moments gracefully.
process_discipline_notes: No violations detected; no differentiators repeated, no silence-hold failures.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Let's start with a few questions to get us on the right track. That should take about five to ten minutes and then we'll be able to build you an accurate quote.
evidence_quotes.agenda: And then do you have any questions or concerns specifically that you want answered on this call?
evidence_quotes.agenda_problem: Asked AFTER rep had already probed for address, date, name, email, referral source — probing started immediately after quid pro quo.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised labor-only vs. truck question; rep answered with a full explanation of what's included, but never asked 'tell me more' or 'what else' — stopped at one answer and moved on to logistics (pickup address).
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: $208 for two movers and 26 foot box truck... two and a half hour minimum. $520 for two and a half hours. No personalization to customer's specific move factors (floor number, distance, complexity).
evidence_quotes.what_missing: No damage coverage / 'careful with' question. No 'Meet Your Mover' / who's coming. No On-Time Guarantee. No Communication (day-before call, crew lead name, updates). No Save Your Ass framing. No rate-lock close. Call ends abruptly when customer says 'we over our address' — rep offers to email, customer pauses, rep pivots to value messaging on pricing, then call ends.

top_strength: Delivered a clear, comprehensive answer to the labor-only question — explained what's included, addressed liability constraints, and kept the customer informed.
coaching_note: Ask the agenda question BEFORE probing for logistics (move date, address, name); and when a concern comes up, drill two layers deep with follow-ups like 'tell me more about that' or 'what else is on your list' instead of one answer and a pivot to data collection.
